**Before filing**

Right-click the pet → **Check my setup**, then press **Test the connection** and
run something in Claude Code while it counts down. That distinguishes the three
things this usually is, and often fixes it outright.

The most common cause is the least interesting one: Claude Code reads its hooks
at startup, so it needs restarting after they are installed.
